name: agent-toolkit
description: Plugins for agent orchestration — spawning, watching, and chaining Claude Code agents across visible terminal surfaces.

plugins.name: agent-toolkit
plugins.description: Spawn Claude Code agents into visible terminal surfaces — cmux surfaces or herdr panes — watch them by push event, and chain multi-stage pipelines across them. Also installs a PreToolUse hook on SendMessage that asks before a message lands in a live session the sending run cannot prove it spawned.
